structured_output.reasoning: Preprocessing (tabular and image mean/std) is fit strictly on the train split after the split is performed, RMSE is computed correctly via np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(...)) without the unsupported squared=False kwarg, and both validation and test predictions come from real forward passes of the trained model rather than placeholders. Architecture, tensor shapes (image [3,256,256], tabular [12]), and FP32-only precision policy (with TF32 gated on confirmed Ampere-or-newer capability) all comply with the task spec and hardware guidance. No data leakage or critical correctness bugs were found; only a minor best-checkpoint-selection gap is noted as a non-blocking warning.

issues.evidence: The training loop runs planned_epochs=2 with no per-epoch validation-loss tracking or checkpoint saving; after the loop, the model object in its final (last-epoch) state is used directly for both validation RMSE computation and test inference, so there is no selection of a best-performing epoch.
issues.repair_instruction: If multi-epoch training is retained, track validation loss per epoch and restore/use the best-performing state_dict for final validation reporting and test inference instead of the last epoch's weights.
